hook.name: AssetToAssetSwapHookForERC4626
hook.description: Periphery hook that automates asset-to-asset swaps for ERC4626 vault-backed pools. In beforeSwap, it converts the user's input asset into vault wrapper shares, performs a nested swap through a companion yield-harvesting pool, then redeems the output shares back to the underlying asset, returning the full delta so the pool itself executes no further swap.
